text: But they can also communicate with the so called roadside units that are antennas that are placed along the road. At intersections, they are typically located with traffic lights. And then this is this roadside unit is a point of access to a vehicle. So in connected cars, we have both the possibility to have device to device communications, direct communications, as well as the communication between the users and the roadside unit that is a piece of infrastructure. So this is the hybrid architectural scenario that we may have in our future. And to finish with the possible type of architecture, I would like also to mention this other example that is represented by the so called mesh networks. We will not spend more time on on this. This is on the only slides I have got on this particular type of technology. It is standardized by IEEE. But it is quite interesting. They are called mesh networks. And as I said, this is a standard. So it's a type of technology. What are they? Well, they are types of networks that use a particular version of Wi-Fi. That's one.
